name: v0.18.0
body:
# sccache 0.18.0

## Summary

sccache 0.18.0 is a broad correctness and coverage release: a lot of compiler flags that used to
force a cache miss are now understood, several cache-key and multi-level storage bugs are fixed,
and the Azure backend gained passwordless authentication.

Highlights:

- **Cache-key correctness**: the assembler gcc/clang would actually invoke is now part of the cache
  key, so two toolchains with different binutils can no longer hand each other the wrong object
  file (#2843). `SCCACHE_BASEDIRS` now also strips base directories from the compiler arguments,
  so flags like `-ffile-prefix-map=/home/user/project=.` stop tying an entry to one checkout
  (#2840).
- **MSVC/clang flag coverage**: support for `/openmp:llvm`, the `/fsanitize*`, `/fsanitize-coverage*`
  and `/fno-sanitize*` families, `/feature`, arm64EC and fastfail, `/d20bforceinline`, and a large
  batch of other flags (#2807, #2830, #2831, #2832), plus more clang CLI options (#2834). gcc now
  marks flags as `TooHard` when they would require caching something else (#2833).
- **CUDA**: `nvcc` dryrun parsing works with CUDA 13.3 (#2722), escaped quotes in Windows dryrun
  lines are protected before backslash flattening (#2811), and the
  `--diag-error`/`--diag-suppress`/`--diag-warn` family is accepted (#2816).
- **Multi-level cache**: a chain with any writable level is writable again — a single read-only
  level no longer makes the whole storage read-only (#2778) — and reads are no longer issued twice
  (#2835).
- **Azure**: Microsoft Entra ID (passwordless) authentication for the Azure Blob backend, for
  storage accounts that disable shared-key access (#2802).
- **Distributed compilation**: rlibs are no longer trimmed from crates that also emit a cdylib,
  which made those jobs fail on the build server (#2839).
- **Process handling**: the jobserver is no longer handed to children that can't use it, which
  restores the `posix_spawn` fast path for child spawns (#2827), and daemonization now uses an
  allow-list for inherited file descriptors, fixing `make` deadlocks caused by leaked jobserver FDs
  (#2841).
- **MSRV** is now 1.91.0 (#2793).

Welcome to 11 new contributors!

## Features
* feat: add Microsoft Entra ID (passwordless) auth for the Azure Blob backend by @babrekel in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2802
* gcc, clang: make the assembler part of the cache key by @glandium in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2843
* Strip basedirs from the compiler arguments too by @avikivity in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2840
* cache: allow skipping capability checks by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2822
* Optimize child process spawns by skipping job server configs by @rnk in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2827

## Compiler support
* feat: add support for MSVC's /d20bforceinline. by @AJIOB in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2807
* msvc: support arm64EC and fastfail flags by @AJIOB in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2830
* msvc: backport flags support by @AJIOB in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2831
* msvc: support lots of flags by @AJIOB in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2832
* clang: support more CLI options by @AJIOB in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2834
* gcc: mark flags as TooHard if need to cache something else by @AJIOB in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2833
* nvcc: accept the --diag-error/--diag-suppress/--diag-warn family by @Kataglyphis in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2816

## Fixes
* Fix `nvcc` dryrun parsing for CUDA 13.3 by @mbrobbel in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2722
* nvcc (Windows): protect escaped quotes in dryrun lines before flattening backslashes by @Kataglyphis in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2811
* multilevel: a chain with any writable level is writable by @tycho in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2778
* cache: avoid duplicate multilevel reads by @zfaustk in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2835
* Resolving always-false conditional making some compilers miss for preprocessor checks by @Joldiges in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2824
* dist: refuse to trim rlibs from crates that also emit a cdylib by @gaetschwartz in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2839
* daemonize: use an allow-list approach to inherited FDs by @schopin-mozilla in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2841

## Dependencies
* Bump opendal to 0.58.1 and fix fallout (fixes local GCS cache usage) by @flip1995 in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2715
* Update shlex dependency to version 2 by @musicinmybrain in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2836
* Bump MSRV to 1.91.0 by @flip1995 in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2793

## Tests & CI
* Fixed hardcoded binary path in test by @ranger-ross in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2790
* ci: dump sccache logs on integration failures by @JalenBuildsHub in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2851
* tests/integration: replace MinIO with Silo by @avikivity in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2853

## Cleanup
* Add an agent file by @sylvestre in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2812
* chore: fix typo in comment by @AJIOB in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2829
* Release 0.18.0 by @sylvestre in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2848

## New Contributors
* @mbrobbel made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2722
* @flip1995 made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2793
* @babrekel made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2802
* @Kataglyphis made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2811

* @Joldiges made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2824
* @tycho made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2778
* @JalenBuildsHub made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2851
* @zfaustk made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2835
* @gaetschwartz made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2839
* @rnk made their first contribution in https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/pull/2827
